evidence: Carries the Mining label and adds TxCollection to the node and mining interfaces to construct and validate external block templates against the mempool.
rationale: Provides strategically important interface support for external mining protocols like Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers. By matching requested WTXIDs against Bitcoin Core's mempool and only fetching missing transactions, it removes the need for external mining coordinators to run a redundant mirror mempool.
